summary: Resolve one effective Algolia application ID from all saved sources into the endpoint and required request header.
reason: A separately saved ID must still load when the config holds an API key, whether it is in a sibling or global credentials file. A legacy placeholder must not hide a valid saved ID, generic headers must not override it, and missing settings need a useful bootstrap error.
validated_outcome: Local tests verify IDs from sibling and global credentials, saved templates, and the environment, including placeholder recovery and matching request endpoint/header, plus an actionable missing-ID error.
